App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.

Asset-specific notes: portrait-sea.png, the profile picture for recipient “The sea”, NOT a person. Image 1 is design/art/style-sheet.png, the exact style reference. Image 2 is design/art/vessels/vessel-bottle.png, the exact bottle design reference (clear glass blue, cork, rolled cream letter tied with wax-red ribbon). Image 3 is design/art/portraits/portrait-01.png, ONLY the exact framing and line-thickness guide; do not copy the person.
The block’s “object fills about 70% / generous padding” framing is OVERRIDDEN by this portrait framing: square 1024×1024, circular background disc center (505,526), radius 430, exactly the same disc size/position as Image 3, transparent outside. A pale sea-glass-blue disc around RGB (205,222,236) with a soft cream-to-glass-blue dusk sky band and gentle ink-blue sea in its lower portion. ONE large central message-in-a-bottle floating at a slight tilt, cork towards upper right, filling the disc the way a head and shoulders fill Image 3. The bottle silhouette must be unmistakable at 24px: simple broad shapes, slightly thicker clean plum/navy outline than vessel art, very minimal hatching, clear white glass highlight, visible rolled cream letter. Only two or three simple wave lines in ink blue/light blue. Calm, tender and hopeful. No people, faces, hands, text, letters, numbers, logos or brands. Do not make a map or flag.

Asset-specific notes: scene-sea-sealed.png, the scene after a sea bottle is sent. Image 1 is design/art/style-sheet.png, used ONLY for line weight, palette, paper texture and hand-inked storybook style, NOT its lineup or composition. Image 2 is design/art/vessels/vessel-bottle.png, the bottle design reference: glass blue, corked, rolled cream letter tied with wax-red ribbon clearly inside. Image 3 is design/art/scenes/scene-sealed.png, ONLY for the landscape vignette and softly feathered alpha-edge treatment; do not copy the hands, letter scene or composition.
The block’s square canvas and “object fills about 70% / generous padding” are OVERRIDDEN by these LANDSCAPE SCENE rules: 1536×1024 landscape; genuine transparent background with soft feathered vignette edges, only the central illustration visible, all four corners alpha 0. One corked message-in-a-bottle drifts away on a calm dusk sea, bottle modest in the middle distance (about one quarter of illustration width), at a slight tilt with cork toward upper right. A few small ripples trail behind it. Low far shore: a soft anonymous headland/line of dunes along the distant horizon, not a recognizable location or map. Warm brass/cream dusk glow low in the sky, ink-blue/light-blue water. Optionally two tiny distant gull marks. Mood is letting go: calm, tender, hopeful, a little lonely. Simple elegant composition with open breathing space; light hatching, flat colour plus one soft shading tone and a little paper grain. No people, faces, hands, boats, other vessels, text, letters, numbers, logos, brands or watermark. No opaque rectangular paper background, no dark/gray border.
